title: GROUNDWAR KILL ALL RAPIDFIRE SILENT AIM INF AMMO ESP
features:
✨ FEATURES
🎯 Combat
Silent Aim – Redirect bullets to nearest enemy in FOV

Ragebot – Full 360° auto‑aim, picks closest target by world distance

Triggerbot – Auto‑fire when enemy enters crosshair

Wallbang – Bullets penetrate through any surface

Insta Hit – Instant bullet travel (no delay)

Rapid Fire – Max fire rate, overrides any RPM limit

Force Automatic – Turns semi‑auto & bolt‑action guns into full‑auto

Infinite Ammo – Never reload, always max ammo

Refill Ammo – Manual ammo refill button

👁️ ESP & Visuals
Player ESP – Names, boxes (corner/normal), health bars, distance, weapon, skeletons

Chams – Highlight enemies with customizable colors & transparency

Bullet Tracers – See bullet paths with adjustable duration, width, and color

FOV Changer – Adjust camera field of view (50‑120°)

Ambient Changer – Change global lighting color

Viewmodel Chams – ForceField material on gun & hands, fully colorable

🚀 Movement
Flight – Noclip‑style flying with WASD + Space/Shift

Speed Hack – Up to 200 walkspeed

Jump Power – Customizable jump height

🛠️ Misc
Rejoin / Copy Server Link – Quick reconnect

Themes & Configs – Save/load presets, choose from built‑in themes

Clean UI – Smooth animations, drag‑able window (toggle with Right Control)
